architecture: v3 (re-root at stage 2: a county farm-and-home mutual's 2027 windstorm reinsurance, whether to add the second-event cover the broker quoted, valued by the 1-in-200 capital it releases once each simulated storm is costed at what the mutual's claims show for storms like it)
slot_note: re-root of task306 in the same objective (Opportunity Sizing), batch 1
niche: a regional farm and rural home mutual's 2027 windstorm programme, whether to add a second-event cover on the occurrence cover's retained band, its own storms' claims set against the catastrophe model's hindcast, the storms that strike within weeks of the storm before costing more
answer: Add the second-event cover: it releases GBP 7 million of 1-in-200 windstorm capital, worth GBP 0.8 million a year at 12 per cent against a margin of GBP 0.7 million, so it adds GBP 0.1 million a year.
analyst_test: An analyst who reads every field and rule correctly runs the field's model adjustment on the record as one population (total incurred over total hindcast, 1.06, which reproduces the record's total exactly and shows no trend with storm size), costs every simulated storm at it, and files that the second-event cover releases 5 million of 1-in-200 capital and is worth minus 0.3 million a year, so it is not bought.
domain_test: Reinsurance capital relief is the field's own 1-in-200 on simulated years net of the covers in force, and the catastrophe model adjustment to the company's claims against the vendor's hindcast is the field's own calibration; with another field's nouns there is no year loss table, no hindcast, no retained band a second-event cover sits on and no storms whose cost rises because the last storm's repairs are still under way.
layer1: the web form recording the day it is sent as a claim's loss date
the loss adjusters' portal spacing the insurer's claim number
reopened claims carrying a supplementary payment on a suffixed line
the model's hindcast peaks in UTC against claims dated by local damage day
sums insured in thousands of pounds
holdings renumbered by the Rural Payments Agency, the old CPH kept beside the new
a coinsurance register keyed by the CPH as it stood at the arrangement's last renewal
policy renewals under new numbers and lapsed records in the home extract
storm names only from the 2015 season, two claims systems across a 2014 migration
stakeholder_role: the mutual's head of reinsurance, who places the 2027 windstorm programme

spine.entity: one simulated storm in a simulated year

world.org_type: a county farm and rural home mutual insurer

driver: The decisive quantity is the tail of a forward loss distribution built from simulated years of events and calibrated to the organisation's own recorded losses, when an event that strikes within weeks of the event before it costs more per unit of modelled loss than an event on a quiet spell, a class no column marks and only the order of the record's events rebuilds; one pooled calibration across all events undercosts the later events of a run, which are the only ones a cover on second and later events pays on, and values that cover below its cost.
driver_concrete: A windstorm that strikes within weeks of the storm before it, roofs still sheeted and builders still booked, costs the mutual 1.62 times the model's hindcast against 0.98 for every other storm, so each simulated storm that follows another in its year is costed at its class's ratio before the 1-in-200 is read net of the occurrence cover and of both covers; the one ratio over the record, 1.06, undercosts exactly the later storms the second-event cover pays on and values it at minus 0.3 million a year instead of plus 0.1 million.
stump: A competent solver costs every storm in the 2027 year loss table at the record's one incurred-over-hindcast ratio, 1.06, and files that the second-event cover releases 5 million and is worth minus 0.3 million a year, so it is not bought; the step that lands it there is reading the record as one population, when the storms that strike within weeks of the storm before cost 1.62 times the model and the rest 0.98, and the cover pays on exactly those later storms in the years that set the capital.

differentiation.task309: task309 reads one FORTIFIED roof cut ratio by each storm's own local gust class, a column on every claim, carried event by event; here the ratio does not move with a storm's size or intensity at all, and the class that moves it is a storm's place in its season's sequence, rebuilt only by ordering the season's storms by date, and the decision turns on an annual aggregate cover against an occurrence cover in the clustered seasons.
differentiation.task302: task302 nets a unit's lost output against substitutes its group takes while it is out; here nothing is substituted: each storm's own cost rises when it follows another inside a season, and the decisive split is of the record's storms by their place in their season.
differentiation.task120: task120 v3 reads a population's peak draw as inflow less a reserve drawn down; here there is no stock or reserve, and the decisive move is loading the follow-on storms of each simulated season by what the record's own follow-on storms cost.
differentiation.task271: task271 v5 nets each fill's adverse move against the actor's own later child orders inside one parent order, a market-impact window measured in seconds; here no actor trades against itself: a storm's claims cost more when it strikes while an earlier storm's repairs are still open, and the decision is an aggregate against an occurrence reinsurance cover on simulated seasons.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the part of a candidate's second-round effect that stays inside the area, when that round runs through the incomes the candidate pays and a published multiplier carries the area's average share of those incomes spent at home; one candidate's earners mostly live outside the area, which only its operator's roster joined to a location lookup shows, so the multiplier credits it with spending that happens elsewhere and ranks it first.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at stage 2, before any data was cut: the survivor anatomy's Actor test failed on paper, since the deciding property (where the distribution centre's staff live) is one join from a column (the roster's postcode against the postcode directory's local authority) and any shipped residence datum is a column or a sentence, so the decisive rung would be readable; re-rooted into actuarial reinsurance capital

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is next year's failures in an asset base that keeps taking in old units the current roll does not hold yet: a forecast summed over today's roll leaves out the units still to arrive, which arrive past their cover and fail in their first months, so one segment's demand runs a fifth short and its share of a fixed capacity goes to the segments the roll overstates.
